smartphone_display.name: Display
smartphone_display.hint: Warm the edges with a hair dryer to soften the adhesive, then pry the display off with a plastic pick.

smartphone_back_cover.name: Back Cover
smartphone_back_cover.hint: Heat the edges to loosen the glue and lift the cover with a suction cup; wear gloves in case it cracks.

laptop_display.name: Display Panel
laptop_display.hint: Unscrew the hinges and disconnect the display cable before lifting the panel out.

tablet_display.name: Display
tablet_display.hint: Heat the edges and work around the frame with a plastic pick to release the adhesive.

smartwatch_display.name: Display
smartwatch_display.hint: Heat briefly and lift with a thin blade; the battery sits directly underneath.

lcd_panel.name: LCD Panel
lcd_panel.hint: Remove the back cover screws; handle the panel flat, it breaks easily.

lens_glass.name: Lens
lens_glass.hint: Unscrew the head of the flashlight to take the lens out.

aluminium_frame.name: Frame
aluminium_frame.hint: Remains after display, battery and board are removed.

aluminium_housing.name: Housing
aluminium_housing.hint: Remove all screws and internal parts first; the empty shell is pure aluminium.

aluminium_heat_sink.name: Heat Sink
aluminium_heat_sink.hint: Twist off the diffuser and pull out the LED module to free the heat sink.

li_ion_battery.name: Lithium-Ion Battery
li_ion_battery.hint: Never puncture or bend it; tape the contacts and bring it to a battery collection point.

alkaline_cell.name: Battery
alkaline_cell.hint: Remove from the device and tape the contacts before handing it in.

circuit_board.name: Circuit Board
circuit_board.hint: Unscrew and unplug all ribbon cables; hand in at an e-waste collection point.

sim_tray.name: SIM Tray
sim_tray.hint: Push a SIM tool into the small hole next to the tray.

electric_motor.name: Electric Motor
electric_motor.hint: Unscrew from the housing and cut the wires; contains copper windings and magnets.

speaker_driver.name: Speaker
speaker_driver.hint: Contains a strong magnet; keep away from cards and other electronics.

led_module.name: LED Module
led_module.hint: Pull it out of the socket or unscrew it from the reflector.

led_backlight.name: LED Backlight
led_backlight.hint: LED strips sit behind the diffuser sheets at the panel edges or back.

thermostat.name: Thermostat
thermostat.hint: Located under the base plate; unscrew the bottom cover to reach it.

copper_heat_pipe.name: Heat Pipe
copper_heat_pipe.hint: Unscrew the cooler assembly from the board and peel off the thermal pads.

cable_copper_core.name: Cable Wires
cable_copper_core.hint: Cut off the plug and strip the insulation to free the copper.

cable_insulation.name: Cable Insulation
cable_insulation.hint: Slit lengthwise with a cable stripper to separate it from the wires.

plug_pins.name: Plug Pins
plug_pins.hint: Brass pins are pressed into the housing; break the housing open to remove them.

connector_shell.name: Connector Shell
connector_shell.hint: Cut the cable just behind the connector.

plastic_housing.name: Plastic Housing
plastic_housing.hint: Look for hidden screws under rubber feet or labels, then pry the clips open.

keycaps.name: Keycaps
keycaps.hint: Pull straight up with a keycap puller or a bent paper clip.

steel_backplate.name: Metal Backplate
steel_backplate.hint: Remove after taking out the electronics; check with a magnet.

steel_stand.name: Stand
steel_stand.hint: Press the release button or unscrew the VESA screws.

rubber_scroll_wheel.name: Scroll Wheel
rubber_scroll_wheel.hint: Lift the wheel out of its axle once the housing is open.

silicone_keypad.name: Keypad
silicone_keypad.hint: Lifts out as a single mat once the housing is opened.

silicone_strap.name: Strap
silicone_strap.hint: Push the quick-release pin or button to detach the strap.

silicone_ear_tips.name: Ear Tips
silicone_ear_tips.hint: Pull them off the nozzle by hand.

ear_cushions.name: Ear Cushions
ear_cushions.hint: Twist or pull them off the ear cups; most are clipped in.

bulb_diffuser.name: Diffuser Dome
bulb_diffuser.hint: Twist or pry the dome off the base with a flat tool.

lamp_base.name: Screw Base
lamp_base.hint: Stays attached to the heat sink; hand in the bulb as e-waste if it won't separate.

brush_head.name: Brush Head
brush_head.hint: Pull it straight off the handle; dispose of separately from the handle.

heating_element.name: Heating Element
heating_element.hint: Unplug and let it cool down fully before opening the housing.

stainless_steel_body.name: Body
stainless_steel_body.hint: Remains after removing plastic parts, base and electronics.

plastic_handle.name: Handle
plastic_handle.hint: Usually held by one or two screws.

crumb_tray.name: Crumb Tray
crumb_tray.hint: Slide it out from the bottom of the toaster.

plastic_knobs.name: Knobs and Lever
plastic_knobs.hint: Pull them straight off the shafts.

aluminium_capsule.name: Capsule
aluminium_capsule.hint: Empty the coffee grounds into organic waste before recycling.

aluminium_lid_foil.name: Lid Foil
aluminium_lid_foil.hint: Peel it off completely and put it in the same bin as the cup.

aluminium_capsule_foil.name: Capsule Foil
aluminium_capsule_foil.hint: Cut along the ridge below the neck and pull the foil off.

aluminium_can_body.name: Can
aluminium_can_body.hint: Empty it; leave the tab attached.

aluminium_spray_can_body.name: Can
aluminium_spray_can_body.hint: Only recycle when completely empty; never pierce or crush a spray can.

aluminium_cup.name: Cup
aluminium_cup.hint: Let the wax cool and push it out from below.

pet_bottle_body.name: Bottle
pet_bottle_body.hint: Empty it and flatten lengthwise; return it if it carries a deposit logo.

hdpe_screw_cap.name: Screw Cap
hdpe_screw_cap.hint: Twist off; recycle it separately or keep it on as local rules require.

plastic_label.name: Label
plastic_label.hint: Tear along the seam or cut it off.

pp_flip_cap.name: Flip Cap
pp_flip_cap.hint: Unscrew it from the bottle or tube.

glass_container.name: Glass
glass_container.hint: Empty it and sort it by colour into the glass bin.

crown_cap.name: Crown Cap
crown_cap.hint: Use a bottle opener; it goes in the metal collection.

twist_off_lid.name: Lid
twist_off_lid.hint: Unscrew it and put it in the metal collection.

cork_stopper.name: Cork
cork_stopper.hint: Pull it out with a corkscrew; collect natural corks separately.

paper_label.name: Paper Label
paper_label.hint: Soak in warm water to peel it off; leaving it on is usually fine.

steel_can_body.name: Can
steel_can_body.hint: Rinse it; check with a magnet to tell it apart from aluminium.

steel_can_lid.name: Lid
steel_can_lid.hint: Push the sharp lid into the empty can before recycling.

carton_body.name: Carton
carton_body.hint: Empty and flatten it; do not separate the layers.

pp_cup_body.name: Cup
pp_cup_body.hint: Scrape it empty; there is no need to rinse it.

cardboard_sleeve.name: Cardboard Sleeve
cardboard_sleeve.hint: Tear along the perforation or slide it off.

coated_paper_cup.name: Cup
coated_paper_cup.hint: Has a plastic lining, so it does not go in paper recycling.

ps_cup_lid.name: Lid
ps_cup_lid.hint: Pull it off the cup rim.

cardboard_box_body.name: Box
cardboard_box_body.hint: Flatten it; tear off heavily greasy or food-soiled parts first.

packing_tape.name: Packing Tape
packing_tape.hint: Peel it off before flattening the box.

paper_sheets.name: Paper
paper_sheets.hint: Remove any plastic wrap or inserts.

ldpe_film.name: Film
ldpe_film.hint: Empty it and fold or ball it up loosely.

multilayer_film.name: Bag
multilayer_film.hint: Shake it empty; the metallised layer cannot be separated.

toothpaste_tube_body.name: Tube
toothpaste_tube_body.hint: Squeeze it empty; there is no need to rinse it.

spray_valve.name: Valve
spray_valve.hint: Crimped onto the can; do not try to remove it.

pen_barrel.name: Barrel
pen_barrel.hint: Unscrew the barrel to release the refill.

ink_refill.name: Ink Refill
ink_refill.hint: Replace the refill instead of the whole pen.

wooden_pencil_body.name: Wooden Body
wooden_pencil_body.hint: Lacquered wood; do not compost it.

rubber_eraser.name: Eraser
rubber_eraser.hint: Pinch the ferrule open with pliers to pull it out.

steel_blades.name: Blades
steel_blades.hint: Unscrew the pivot screw; wrap the blades before disposal.

plastic_handles.name: Handles
plastic_handles.hint: Often moulded on; cut them off if they won't come off.

steel_frame.name: Frame and Ribs
steel_frame.hint: Cut the fabric off at the rib tips.

polyester_canopy.name: Canopy
polyester_canopy.hint: Unpick the stitches at the rib tips and centre.

textile_upper.name: Upper
textile_upper.hint: Cut it away along the sole seam; donate wearable shoes instead.

foam_midsole.name: Midsole
foam_midsole.hint: Glued to the outsole; separate with a heat gun and a knife.

rubber_outsole.name: Outsole
rubber_outsole.hint: Peel it off the midsole after heating the glue.

cotton_fabric.name: Fabric
cotton_fabric.hint: Donate if wearable; otherwise use the textile collection.

care_label.name: Care Label
care_label.hint: Cut it off at the seam.

denim_fabric.name: Denim
denim_fabric.hint: Cut off rivets and buttons before textile recycling.

metal_rivets.name: Rivets and Buttons
metal_rivets.hint: Cut the fabric around each one.

metal_zipper.name: Zipper
metal_zipper.hint: Cut along both sides of the zipper tape.

plastic_buckles.name: Buckles
plastic_buckles.hint: Cut the straps just behind the buckle.

foam_padding.name: Padding
foam_padding.hint: Open the inner lining seam to pull it out.

plastic_frame.name: Frame
plastic_frame.hint: Unscrew the hinges to separate the temples.

tinted_lenses.name: Lenses
tinted_lenses.hint: Push them out of the frame from the inside.

hinge_screws.name: Hinge Screws
hinge_screws.hint: Unscrew them with a precision screwdriver.

tire_rubber.name: Tread
tire_rubber.hint: Take the tire to a bike shop or tire collection point.

steel_bead_wire.name: Bead Wire
steel_bead_wire.hint: Cut the rubber away along the rim edge.

tire_casing_fabric.name: Casing
tire_casing_fabric.hint: Vulcanised into the rubber; it cannot be separated by hand.

disc_body.name: Disc
disc_body.hint: Scratch it to make the data unreadable; some shops collect CDs.

cd_case.name: Jewel Case
cd_case.hint: Take out the booklet and the disc.

paper_booklet.name: Booklet
paper_booklet.hint: Slide it out from under the clips.

paraffin_wax.name: Wax
paraffin_wax.hint: Collect leftovers and melt them into new candles.

cotton_wick.name: Wick
cotton_wick.hint: Pull it out of the warm wax.

wick_holder.name: Wick Holder
wick_holder.hint: Small metal disc at the bottom of the wick.

steel_pc_case.name: Case
steel_pc_case.hint: Remove the side panel thumbscrews, then unscrew all drives and boards; the empty case is sheet steel.

plastic_front_panel.name: Front Panel
plastic_front_panel.hint: Pull firmly at the bottom edge; it is held by plastic clips.

power_supply_unit.name: Power Supply
power_supply_unit.hint: Unscrew it from the case; do not open it, the capacitors can hold a charge.

hard_drive.name: Hard Drive
hard_drive.hint: Unscrew it from the drive bay; wipe or physically destroy it to protect your data.

cpu_cooler.name: CPU Cooler
cpu_cooler.hint: Release the clips or screws, twist gently to break the thermal paste, then wipe it clean.

thumbstick_caps.name: Thumbstick Caps
thumbstick_caps.hint: Pull them straight up off the sticks.

vibration_motor.name: Vibration Motor
vibration_motor.hint: Unclip it from the grip and cut the wires.

router_antennas.name: Antennas
router_antennas.hint: Unscrew external antennas by hand; internal ones are glued to the housing.

power_adapter.name: Power Adapter
power_adapter.hint: Unplug it and hand it in together with the device as e-waste.

speaker_fabric_cover.name: Fabric Cover
speaker_fabric_cover.hint: Pry off the base, then roll the fabric sleeve upwards.

camera_lens_unit.name: Lens Unit
camera_lens_unit.hint: Unscrew it from the body; it contains glass elements and a small motor.

memory_card.name: Memory Card
memory_card.hint: Push to release it; wipe it or keep it, it may still hold photos.

e_ink_display.name: E-Ink Display
e_ink_display.hint: Heat the bezel edge and lift carefully; the screen is very thin and cracks easily.

rubber_shell.name: Rubber Shell
rubber_shell.hint: Peel back the rubber end caps to reach the screws.

speaker_grille.name: Grille
speaker_grille.hint: Pry it off with a flat tool; it is clipped or glued around the edge.

lamp_arm.name: Arm
lamp_arm.hint: Unscrew the joint bolts to separate the segments.

lamp_shade.name: Shade
lamp_shade.hint: Unscrew the ring that holds the shade to the socket.

steel_lamp_base.name: Weighted Base
steel_lamp_base.hint: Open the base plate to cut the cable free.

fan_blades.name: Blades
fan_blades.hint: Unscrew the spinner cap in front of the blades, then pull them off the shaft.

fan_guard.name: Guard
fan_guard.hint: Undo the clips around the rim to split the front and rear guard.

vacuum_hose.name: Hose
vacuum_hose.hint: Twist and pull it off the inlet.

dust_bag.name: Dust Bag
dust_bag.hint: Remove it full and put it in residual waste; used bags cannot be recycled.

hepa_filter.name: Filter
hepa_filter.hint: Tap it out over a bin; filters full of fine dust go in residual waste.

blender_jar.name: Jar
blender_jar.hint: Lift it off the base; check the bottom for a material code.

blender_blade.name: Blade Assembly
blender_blade.hint: Unscrew the bottom ring of the jar; the blades are very sharp, wrap them before disposal.

steel_microwave_cavity.name: Cavity
steel_microwave_cavity.hint: Leave opening to an e-waste centre: the capacitor inside can hold a lethal charge even when unplugged.

glass_turntable.name: Turntable
glass_turntable.hint: Lift it out; heat-resistant glass must not go in the glass bin.

magnetron.name: Magnetron
magnetron.hint: Do not remove it yourself; it contains ceramic insulators and strong magnets.

water_tank.name: Water Tank
water_tank.hint: Lift it out of the device; it usually clips in from the top or back.

water_pump.name: Pump
water_pump.hint: Pull off the hoses and unscrew the pump from the frame.

mixer_beaters.name: Beaters
mixer_beaters.hint: Press the eject button to release them.

shaver_foil_head.name: Shaving Head
shaver_foil_head.hint: Press the release button and lift the head off.

ceramic_plates.name: Ceramic Plates
ceramic_plates.hint: Let it cool down fully, then unclip the plate frame from each arm.

iron_soleplate.name: Soleplate
iron_soleplate.hint: Unscrew the plastic housing from above; the soleplate is bolted to it.

solar_cell.name: Solar Cell
solar_cell.hint: Glued into the top of the housing; hand it in with e-waste.

button_cell.name: Button Cell
button_cell.hint: Open the battery lid and lift it out; tape both sides and hand it in at a battery collection point.

piezo_buzzer.name: Buzzer
piezo_buzzer.hint: Leave it on the board. Older detectors with a radiation symbol must go to a hazardous waste point.

rocker_switch.name: Switch
rocker_switch.hint: Pop it out of the housing with a small screwdriver.

webcam_lens.name: Lens
webcam_lens.hint: Twist the lens barrel off the sensor board.

ink_cartridge.name: Ink Cartridge
ink_cartridge.hint: Open the cover and press the cartridge down to release it; many shops take cartridges back.

steel_rail.name: Carriage Rail
steel_rail.hint: Unscrew it from the side frames after removing the print head.

drill_chuck.name: Chuck
drill_chuck.hint: Open it fully, remove the left-hand screw inside, then unscrew the chuck with a hex key.

gearbox.name: Gearbox
gearbox.hint: Lift it out together with the motor once the housing halves are apart.

battery_pack.name: Battery Pack
battery_pack.hint: Slide it off the tool and hand it in at a battery collection point without opening it.

telescopic_antenna.name: Antenna
telescopic_antenna.hint: Unscrew the nut at its base inside the housing.

fluorescent_tube.name: Glass Tube
fluorescent_tube.hint: Contains mercury: do not break it, hand in the whole lamp at a collection point.

cooling_fan.name: Fan
cooling_fan.hint: Unplug the fan cable from the board and unscrew it.

audio_jack.name: Jack Plug
audio_jack.hint: Cut the cable just behind the plug.

battery_box.name: Battery Box
battery_box.hint: Slide the cover off and take out the batteries first.

glass_platform.name: Glass Top
glass_platform.hint: Tempered glass: unscrew it from below; it can shatter if knocked at the edge.

load_cell.name: Load Cell
load_cell.hint: Unscrew it and cut the thin wires; it is a solid aluminium block with sensors.

nonstick_plates.name: Baking Plates
nonstick_plates.hint: Unscrew the plates from inside each shell; the coating stays on them.

soldering_tip.name: Tip
soldering_tip.hint: Let it cool, unscrew the sleeve nut and pull the tip off.

propellers.name: Propellers
propellers.hint: Unscrew or push-and-twist them off the motors.

molded_pulp_tray.name: Tray
molded_pulp_tray.hint: Tear it into pieces; it goes in paper waste or the compost.

pp_food_tray.name: Tray
pp_food_tray.hint: Scrape out food leftovers; there is no need to rinse it.

eps_tray.name: Foam Tray
eps_tray.hint: Peel off the film and pad first, then break it up for the bin.

absorbent_pad.name: Absorbent Pad
absorbent_pad.hint: Pull it out and put it in residual waste.

aluminium_foil_sheet.name: Foil
aluminium_foil_sheet.hint: Scrunch clean pieces into a fist-sized ball so the sorting machine catches it.

pvc_blister.name: Blister
pvc_blister.hint: Push out all tablets; hand in leftover medicine at a pharmacy.

child_safe_cap.name: Child-Safe Cap
child_safe_cap.hint: Push down and turn at the same time.

trigger_sprayer.name: Trigger Sprayer
trigger_sprayer.hint: Unscrew it; the spring and dip tube stay attached, so keep it as one piece.

pump_dispenser.name: Pump
pump_dispenser.hint: Unscrew it; it contains a small steel spring, dispose of it as plastic packaging.

paper_envelope_body.name: Envelope
paper_envelope_body.hint: Remove any plastic parts before putting it in paper waste.

bubble_lining.name: Bubble Lining
bubble_lining.hint: Tear the paper along the seam and pull the lining out.

paper_bag_body.name: Bag
paper_bag_body.hint: Tear off the handles if they are glued with plastic.

tissue_paper.name: Tissue Paper
tissue_paper.hint: Reuse it for wrapping; otherwise put it in paper waste.

aluminium_tray_body.name: Tray
aluminium_tray_body.hint: Scrape out leftovers; small food residue is fine.

cardboard_lid.name: Lid
cardboard_lid.hint: Usually laminated on the inside; put it in residual waste.

filter_paper.name: Filter Bag
filter_paper.hint: Compost plastic-free bags together with the tea leaves.

staple.name: Staple
staple.hint: Pull it out with your fingernail or pliers.

pp_straw.name: Straw
pp_straw.hint: Too small for most sorting machines; rinse and reuse it if you can.

degassing_valve.name: Aroma Valve
degassing_valve.hint: Cut it out of the bag with scissors.

deodorant_bottle.name: Bottle
deodorant_bottle.hint: Pry out the ball insert with a spoon handle and rinse.

roller_ball.name: Roller Ball
roller_ball.hint: Lever it out together with its holder.

lipstick_case.name: Case
lipstick_case.hint: Scrape out remaining product with a cotton swab.

lipstick_bullet.name: Lipstick
lipstick_bullet.hint: Scrape it out into residual waste.

pp_jar_body.name: Jar
pp_jar_body.hint: Scrape it empty with a spatula; leftover cream goes in residual waste.

fruit_net_mesh.name: Net
fruit_net_mesh.hint: Cut off any metal clips first.

ldpe_rings.name: Rings
ldpe_rings.hint: Cut every ring open so animals cannot get caught in them.

multilayer_bag.name: Inner Bag
multilayer_bag.hint: Pull it out through the tap hole and empty it.

pp_tap.name: Tap
pp_tap.hint: Pull it out of the bag spout.

hdpe_crate_body.name: Crate
hdpe_crate_body.hint: Return it to the shop; crates carry a deposit and are reused for years.

pp_bucket_body.name: Bucket
pp_bucket_body.hint: Empty it; let paint or plaster leftovers dry out completely first.

steel_handle.name: Handle
steel_handle.hint: Unhook it from the side lugs.

perfume_pump.name: Spray Pump
perfume_pump.hint: Crimped onto the neck; lever the collar off with pliers.

squeeze_bottle_body.name: Bottle
squeeze_bottle_body.hint: Unscrew the cap and scrape out leftovers.

sponge_foam.name: Sponge
sponge_foam.hint: Goes in residual waste; cut old sponges into small cleaning pads instead.

scrub_pad.name: Scouring Pad
scrub_pad.hint: Glued to the sponge; it cannot be separated.

toothbrush_handle.name: Handle
toothbrush_handle.hint: Pull out the bristles with pliers if you want clean plastic.

nylon_bristles.name: Bristles
nylon_bristles.hint: Anchored with tiny metal staples; pull them out with pliers.

razor_handle.name: Handle
razor_handle.hint: Snap the head off the handle.

razor_blade_head.name: Blade Head
razor_blade_head.hint: Very sharp: wrap it in tape before putting it in residual waste.

hairbrush_body.name: Body
hairbrush_body.hint: Pull out the rubber cushion with the bristles first.

rubber_cushion.name: Cushion
rubber_cushion.hint: Pry the edge out of the body with a flat tool.

plastic_comb.name: Comb
plastic_comb.hint: Solid plastic; reuse it as long as possible.

pot_lid_glass.name: Glass Lid
pot_lid_glass.hint: Unscrew the knob; heat-resistant glass does not go in the glass bin.

nonstick_pan_body.name: Pan
nonstick_pan_body.hint: The coating cannot be removed; hand it in as scrap metal.

bakelite_handle.name: Handle
bakelite_handle.hint: Unscrew the bolt or drill out the rivets holding it to the pan.

ceramic_body.name: Mug
ceramic_body.hint: Ceramic does not belong in the glass bin; broken pieces go in residual waste.

drinking_glass_body.name: Glass
drinking_glass_body.hint: Drinking glass melts differently from bottles; put it in residual waste, not the glass bin.

knife_blade.name: Blade
knife_blade.hint: Wrap the blade in cardboard before disposal.

knife_handle.name: Handle
knife_handle.hint: Usually moulded on; cut it off with a saw if needed.

wooden_board.name: Board
wooden_board.hint: Oiled wood; sand it down and reuse it, or put it in residual waste.

wooden_spoon_body.name: Spoon
wooden_spoon_body.hint: Untreated wood can go in the compost or residual waste.

silicone_seal.name: Seal
silicone_seal.hint: Pull it out of the groove in the lid.

steel_wire.name: Wire
steel_wire.hint: Many dry cleaners take hangers back; otherwise it goes in the metal collection.

ps_hanger_body.name: Hanger
ps_hanger_body.hint: Reuse it or return it to a clothing store that collects them.

steel_hook.name: Hook
steel_hook.hint: Twist it out of the hanger with pliers.

peg_halves.name: Peg Halves
peg_halves.hint: Twist the halves apart to release the spring.

wooden_frame.name: Frame
wooden_frame.hint: Bend up the metal tabs at the back to remove the backing.

frame_glass.name: Glass Pane
frame_glass.hint: Flat glass does not belong in the glass bin; wrap it and put it in residual waste.

cardboard_backing.name: Backing
cardboard_backing.hint: Lift it out after bending the tabs.

brass_key.name: Key
brass_key.hint: Brass is valuable scrap; collect old keys and hand them in with metal.

padlock_body.name: Body
padlock_body.hint: Brass lock body; take it to a scrap metal dealer.

steel_shackle.name: Shackle
steel_shackle.hint: Cut it with bolt cutters only if the key is lost.

butyl_tube.name: Tube
butyl_tube.hint: Patch it instead of throwing it away; old tubes make great straps.

tube_valve.name: Valve
tube_valve.hint: Cut it out with a sharp knife.

pvc_hose.name: Hose
pvc_hose.hint: Cut it into pieces; it often contains a polyester mesh.

hose_connector.name: Connector
hose_connector.hint: Unscrew the clamp ring and pull it off.

pp_plant_pot.name: Pot
pp_plant_pot.hint: Knock out the soil; black pots are often missed by sorting machines.

broom_bristles.name: Bristles
broom_bristles.hint: Stapled into the head; leave them in.

wooden_handle.name: Handle
wooden_handle.hint: Separate it from the metal or plastic part and reuse it.

silicone_tray.name: Tray
silicone_tray.hint: Silicone is not accepted in packaging waste; put it in residual waste.

steel_baking_tray.name: Tray
steel_baking_tray.hint: Enamelled or coated steel; hand it in with scrap metal.

steel_cutlery.name: Fork
steel_cutlery.hint: Stainless steel lasts forever; donate it or hand it in as scrap metal.

steel_stapler_body.name: Stapler Arm
steel_stapler_body.hint: Remove the staples, then knock out the hinge pin.

plastic_base.name: Base
plastic_base.hint: Pry it off the steel arm.

cardboard_cover.name: Cover
cardboard_cover.hint: Peel off any plastic film before putting it in paper waste.

ring_mechanism.name: Ring Mechanism
ring_mechanism.hint: Drill out or pry open the two rivets.

marker_ink_reservoir.name: Ink Reservoir
marker_ink_reservoir.hint: Pull out the back plug and slide it out; many markers can be refilled.

ps_ruler.name: Ruler
ps_ruler.hint: Brittle polystyrene; reuse it rather than recycling it.

eraser_block.name: Eraser
eraser_block.hint: Peel off the paper sleeve and use it up completely.

glue_stick_tube.name: Tube
glue_stick_tube.hint: Twist down fully and scrape out leftover glue.

ps_dispenser_body.name: Dispenser
ps_dispenser_body.hint: Pull the tape roll out of the holder.

steel_cutting_blade.name: Blade
steel_cutting_blade.hint: Pry it out of its slot and wrap it before disposal.

window_film.name: Window
window_film.hint: Tear it out; small windows are usually fine in paper waste.

cartridge_chip.name: Chip
cartridge_chip.hint: Glued on the side; leave it, refill stations reuse it.

ink_sponge.name: Ink Sponge
ink_sponge.hint: Do not open it, the ink stains; refill or return the cartridge instead.

pp_sheet.name: Sheet
pp_sheet.hint: Remove paper contents; clean sheets go in plastic recycling.

sharpener_body.name: Body
sharpener_body.hint: Unscrew the tiny screw to free the blade.

sharpener_blade.name: Blade
sharpener_blade.hint: Replace just the blade when it gets dull.

hardboard_panel.name: Board
hardboard_panel.hint: Drill out the rivets of the clip to separate it.

wool_fabric.name: Knit
wool_fabric.hint: Donate it if wearable; otherwise unravel it to reuse the yarn.

leather_strap.name: Strap
leather_strap.hint: Unscrew the buckle screw or unpick the stitching around it.

belt_buckle.name: Buckle
belt_buckle.hint: Unscrew it from the strap end.

leather_upper.name: Upper
leather_upper.hint: Bring wearable shoes to a shoe container; otherwise cut the upper away from the sole.

visor_insert.name: Visor Insert
visor_insert.hint: Cut open the visor seam and slide it out.

polyester_fill.name: Insulation
polyester_fill.hint: Cut open the lining to pull out the fill; reuse it as stuffing.

leather_panel.name: Leather
leather_panel.hint: Unpick the seams to get flat pieces.

polyester_lining.name: Lining
polyester_lining.hint: Cut it out along the inner seam.

eva_sole.name: Sole
eva_sole.hint: Push the strap plugs through from below.

rubber_strap.name: Strap
rubber_strap.hint: Push the toe plug out from underneath.

coated_polyester_fabric.name: Coated Fabric
coated_polyester_fabric.hint: The waterproof coating cannot be removed; reuse the fabric for bags.

steel_watch_case.name: Case
steel_watch_case.hint: Use a case knife to pop off the back.

watch_glass.name: Crystal
watch_glass.hint: Pressed into the case; leave it in.

watch_movement.name: Movement
watch_movement.hint: Lift it out after pulling out the crown stem.

abs_brick.name: Brick
abs_brick.hint: Pass them on; ABS bricks last for decades.

pu_cover.name: Cover
pu_cover.hint: Cut along the seams to free the panels.

latex_bladder.name: Bladder
latex_bladder.hint: Pull it out through a cut seam.

rubber_core.name: Core
rubber_core.hint: Cut the ball in half with a saw.

felt_cover.name: Felt
felt_cover.hint: Glued to the core; peel it off after cutting.

foam_mat.name: Mat
foam_mat.hint: Cut it into knee pads or drawer liners.

wooden_deck.name: Deck
wooden_deck.hint: Unscrew the trucks from the top with a skate tool.

aluminium_trucks.name: Trucks
aluminium_trucks.hint: Remove the axle nuts to take off the wheels.

pu_wheels.name: Wheels
pu_wheels.hint: Pull them off the axles after removing the nuts.

steel_bearings.name: Bearings
steel_bearings.hint: Push them out of the wheels with the truck axle.

grip_tape.name: Grip Tape
grip_tape.hint: Heat it with a hair dryer and peel it off the deck.

eps_liner.name: Foam Liner
eps_liner.hint: Replace the helmet after any crash; the foam cannot be repaired.

pc_shell.name: Shell
pc_shell.hint: Glued to the foam; peel it off with a flat tool.

nylon_straps.name: Straps
nylon_straps.hint: Cut them off at the anchors.

ldpe_squeeze_body.name: Bottle
ldpe_squeeze_body.hint: Rinse and reuse it; when worn out it goes in plastic packaging recycling.

polyester_plush.name: Fur Fabric
polyester_plush.hint: Donate clean toys; otherwise open a seam to take out the filling.

plastic_eyes.name: Eyes
plastic_eyes.hint: Fixed with a washer on the inside; cut the fabric around them.

game_board.name: Board
game_board.hint: Folding board with paper on both sides; it goes in paper waste.

wooden_pieces.name: Pieces
wooden_pieces.hint: Keep them as spare pieces for other games.

coated_cards.name: Cards
coated_cards.hint: Plastic-coated cards go in residual waste.

toy_car_body.name: Body
toy_car_body.hint: Drill out the rivets on the bottom to open it.

steel_axles.name: Axles
steel_axles.hint: Pull them out once the base plate is off.

aluminium_racket_frame.name: Frame
aluminium_racket_frame.hint: Cut the strings first; the frame is scrap metal.

nylon_strings.name: Strings
nylon_strings.hint: Cut them across the middle to release the tension safely.

silicone_head_strap.name: Strap
silicone_head_strap.hint: Thread it out of the lens clips.

pp_disc.name: Disc
pp_disc.hint: Solid PP; reuse it or cut it into scoops and trays.

pvc_record.name: Record
pvc_record.hint: Sell or donate it; PVC records are not recycled through household bins.

steel_hammer_head.name: Head
steel_hammer_head.hint: Drive out the wedge and knock the head off the handle.

steel_shaft.name: Shaft
steel_shaft.hint: Moulded into the handle; cut the handle off with a saw.

synthetic_bristles.name: Bristles
synthetic_bristles.hint: Clean and reuse the brush; brushes with dried paint go in residual waste.

steel_tape.name: Tape
steel_tape.hint: The coiled spring snaps back hard; open the housing carefully.

hdpe_cartridge_tube.name: Cartridge
hdpe_cartridge_tube.hint: Let leftover sealant cure; empty cartridges go in plastic packaging.

bulb_glass.name: Glass Bulb
bulb_glass.hint: Old bulbs go in residual waste, not the glass bin.

bulb_screw_base.name: Screw Base
bulb_screw_base.hint: Cemented to the glass; leave it attached.

pp_storage_box.name: Box
pp_storage_box.hint: Remove labels; large rigid plastics go to the recycling centre.

steel_pliers_jaws.name: Jaws
steel_pliers_jaws.hint: Pull the plastic grips off; the steel part goes in scrap metal.
